claims.statement: Across the comps spreadsheet extracts provided, the Notes column is blank for Northgate Business Park, Meridian Holdings Plaza, Cedar Bluff Logistics Center, and Aurelia Corporate Campus.
The Notes column is also blank for Cobalt Harbor Mixed-Use and Wrenfield Business Center.
The Notes column is blank for Sablewood Retail Court, Ridgeline Office Commons, and Thornfield Industrial Park.

The only non-blank entry in the Notes column is for Fenwick Distribution Hub, which states that its single largest tenant, Halvorsen Logistics Group, accounts for 38% of in-place annual base rent. This is factual commentary about tenant concentration rather than an instruction.

citations.quote: Single largest tenant, Halvorsen Logistics Group, accounts for 38% of in-place annual base rent.
